resources.name: Shivam Travels API
resources.description: Complete backend API test suite — auth, bookings, pricing, drivers, vehicles, SEO, validation.

resources.name: 1. Authentication
resources.description: Admin login, session, and password-reset flows.

resources.name: Login - Valid Credentials
resources.description: Expect 200 + accessToken. Copy the token into the access_token env var for subsequent admin requests.

resources.name: Login - Invalid Password
resources.description: Expect 401 Unauthorized with a generic error message (must not reveal whether the email exists).

resources.name: Login - Missing Fields
resources.description: Expect 400 Validation error — password is required.

resources.name: Get Current Admin - Valid Token
resources.description: Expect 200 with the logged-in admin's profile.

resources.name: Get Current Admin - No Token
resources.description: Expect 401 Not authenticated.

resources.name: Get Current Admin - Invalid Token
resources.description: Expect 401 Session expired or invalid token.

resources.name: Refresh Access Token
resources.description: Relies on the HttpOnly refresh cookie set at login. Expect 200 + new accessToken, or 401 if no valid session cookie.

resources.name: Logout
resources.description: Expect 200 and the refresh cookie cleared/invalidated. Should succeed even with an expired access token.

resources.name: Forgot Password - Request OTP
resources.description: Expect 200 (generic response whether or not the email exists, to avoid account enumeration).

resources.name: Verify Reset OTP
resources.description: Expect 400/401 for a wrong OTP; 200 for a correct one (use a real OTP from email/logs in dev).

resources.name: 2. Bookings
resources.description: Booking CRUD, status transitions, pricing edits, driver assignment.

resources.name: Create Booking (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 201 + created booking with a MongoDB _id. Copy that id into booking_id.

resources.name: List Bookings (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 200 + paginated list + pagination metadata.

resources.name: List Bookings - No Token (Unauthorized)
resources.description: Expect 401 — this route has no public access.

resources.name: Get Booking Detail
resources.description: Expect 200 with the full booking document.

resources.name: Get Booking Detail - Non-existent ID
resources.description: Expect 404 Booking not found.

resources.name: Get Booking Detail - Invalid ID Format
resources.description: Expect 400/422 — malformed MongoDB ObjectId, not a 500 crash.

resources.name: Update Booking Status
resources.description: Expect 200 + updated status persisted.

resources.name: Update Booking - Invalid Status Value
resources.description: Expect 400/422 — status must be one of the enum values.

resources.name: Assign Driver to Booking
resources.description: Expect 200 + driver populated on the booking.

resources.name: Assign Driver - Non-existent Driver ID
resources.description: Expect 400/404 — must be rejected, not silently accepted.

resources.name: Update Booking Pricing
resources.description: Expect 200 + saved pricing. Re-run 'Get Booking Detail' afterward to confirm it persisted (not just an optimistic client value).

resources.name: Update Booking Pricing - Negative Price (Validation)
resources.description: Expect 400/422 — negative prices must be rejected server-side.

resources.name: Update Booking Pricing - Unauthorized
resources.description: Expect 401 — no token supplied.

resources.name: 3. Vehicle Pricing
resources.description: Public pricing retrieval + admin-only pricing management.

resources.name: Get Pricing (Public)
resources.description: Expect 200 + current per-vehicle pricing. No auth required — this feeds the public homepage/booking page.

resources.name: Create Pricing (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 201. Copy the returned _id into pricing_id.

resources.name: Update Pricing (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 200. Then re-run 'Get Pricing (Public)' to confirm the new rate is actually returned, not cached/stale.

resources.name: Update Pricing - Unauthorized
resources.description: Expect 401 — pricing writes must never be publicly reachable.

resources.name: Update Pricing - Invalid Negative Rate
resources.description: Expect 400/422 — negative per-km rate must be rejected.

resources.name: Delete Pricing (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 200/204. Re-run 'Get Pricing (Public)' to confirm the entry is actually gone.

resources.name: 4. Drivers
resources.description: Driver roster management + assignment support.

resources.name: List Drivers (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 200 + driver list, including availability status.

resources.name: List Drivers - Unauthorized
resources.description: Expect 401.

resources.name: Create Driver
resources.description: Expect 201. Copy the returned _id into driver_id.

resources.name: Update Driver
resources.description: Expect 200 + updated availability.

resources.name: Update Driver - Non-existent ID
resources.description: Expect 404.

resources.name: Delete Driver
resources.description: Expect 200/204. Confirm with 'List Drivers' afterward that the driver no longer appears.

resources.name: 5. Vehicles
resources.description: Public vehicle catalog + admin fleet management.

resources.name: List Vehicles (Public)
resources.description: Expect 200 + active vehicles only.

resources.name: List All Vehicles (Admin view)
resources.description: Expect 200 including inactive vehicles, for the Admin panel dropdowns.

resources.name: Get Vehicle By Slug
resources.description: Expect 200 + full vehicle detail used by the public VehicleDetail page.

resources.name: Create Vehicle (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 201. Copy _id/slug into vehicle_id/vehicle_slug.

resources.name: Toggle Vehicle Active
resources.description: Expect 200 + isActive flipped. Confirm the vehicle disappears from the public list when deactivated.

resources.name: 6. SEO Management
resources.description: Admin-managed page SEO overrides — new in this delivery.

resources.name: Get Public SEO Settings
resources.description: Expect 200 + a map of every static page's SEO fields (blank until an admin configures them). No auth required — this is exactly what the public pages render into <head>.

resources.name: Update Page SEO - Home (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 200 + saved doc. Then GET /seo/settings again to confirm persistence, and open the public homepage to confirm the new title/description actually render.

resources.name: Update Page SEO - Unauthorized
resources.description: Expect 401 — no token supplied.

resources.name: Update Page SEO - Unknown Page Name
resources.description: Expect 400 — page must be one of the known SEO_PAGES values.

resources.name: Update Page SEO - Invalid OG Image URL
resources.description: Expect 422 — ogImage must be a valid http(s) URL.

resources.name: Update Page SEO - Description Too Long
resources.description: Expect 422 — exceeds the 320-character server-side bound.

resources.name: Get Sitemap.xml
resources.description: Expect 200, Content-Type application/xml, listing all active static + vehicle URLs.

resources.name: Get robots.txt
resources.description: Expect 200, text/plain, disallowing the real admin path and /api/.

resources.name: 7. Business Settings
resources.description: Header/footer/contact info singleton.

resources.name: Update Business Settings - Unauthorized
resources.description: Expect 401.

resources.name: 8. Admin Users
resources.description: Staff account management — Administrator role only.

resources.name: List Admin Users - Non-Administrator Role
resources.description: Expect 403 — requireRole('Administrator') must reject other roles.

resources.name: Get Dashboard Stats (Admin)
resources.description: Expect 200 + real aggregate counts (never mock numbers).

resources.name: Get Dashboard Stats - Unauthorized
resources.description: Expect 401.

resources.name: Translate Text (Admin)
resources.description: Returns 503 TRANSLATION_NOT_CONFIGURED if no TRANSLATION_PROVIDER/API key is set — that is expected/correct behavior, not a bug.

resources.name: 11. Cross-cutting Validation & Auth Checks
resources.description: General-purpose checks the task's checklist calls out explicitly.

resources.name: Any Admin Route - Malformed Bearer Header
resources.description: Expect 401 — extractToken() only recognizes 'Bearer <token>'.

resources.name: Health Check
resources.description: Expect 200 { success: true } — used to confirm the server is reachable at all before running the rest of this collection.

resources.name: Unknown Route (404 handler)
resources.description: Expect 404 with the app's standard JSON error shape, not an HTML stack trace.
